Compared all short stanzas and the final isolated flesh-and-blood line.
reviews.reason: Retain the complete grief narrative and two-mother distinction; the remaining consequential choices depend on unresolved source attachment.
open_questions: In all senses can mean all ways or through the senses; current all-meanings rendering remains provisional.
The final to be loved and cherished may attach to mother or express the daughter’s wish to receive maternal love; current targets choose loving/cherishing the mother and remain provisional.
No biological/adoptive/in-law relationship inferred for amma and ma; daughter supports feminine Hindi speaker, not further biography.
reviews.tradeoff: Do not rewrite the final direction of love as settled or specify the two mothers’ roles; preserve the living-presence versus memory contrast.
